g.text: Egypt’s weather, month by month, at 18 sites
Mean daily maximum, °C: what a normal afternoon reaches. Sites north to south.
Source: NASA POWER climatology (MERRA-2 reanalysis), normals 2001–2020. Modelled averages, not a forecast.
